title: Macedonian churches beg Paul to share in the ministry to the saints
speaker: the churches of Macedonia
note: Reported request (8:4); the rest narrates the Macedonians' example that grounds AUD-51-8-6 (8:6–12).

title: Paul quotes the psalm on the righteous who give to the poor
speaker: Paul, quoting the psalm
note: Quotes Greek Psalm 111:9, inside AUD-21-111-1 (Greek Psalm 111:1–9); link as Additional Scripture.

title: God supplies the generous giver for every good work
speaker: Paul
note: The sowing image of 9:6–7 continues to 9:10–14: God supplies givers, and the gift yields thanksgiving.

title: Wage spiritual warfare, taking every thought captive to obey Christ
speaker: Paul
topic: Major Teachings: The Word of Christ Handed On
note: Paul's appeal (10:1–2) and his non-fleshly warfare (10:3–6); AUD-51-10-7 begins only at 10:7.

title: Paul explains why he proclaimed the gospel free of charge
speaker: Paul
note: Same rationale as 1 Corinthians 9:15–18 (AUD-50-9-15): refusing support so opponents have no pretext.

title: Beware false apostles disguised as servants of righteousness
speaker: Paul
note: Extend its Additional Scripture 2 Corinthians 11:1–6 to 11:1–15; the warning about rival apostles continues.

title: If one must boast, boast of the things of weakness
speaker: Paul
note: Fool's speech culminates in 11:30, the same choice to boast in weakness recorded at 12:9–10.

title: Paul boasts only in weaknesses, not in surpassing revelations
speaker: Paul
note: 12:7 ('because of the surpassing revelations') depends on 12:1–6; 12:5 states the rule of boasting in weakness.

title: Paul refuses to burden or exploit the Corinthians
speaker: Paul
note: Same theme as 11:7–12 and 1 Corinthians 9:15–18; 12:18 recalls Titus's sending (AUD-51-8-16).

title: Parents should store up for their children, not children for parents
speaker: Paul
topic: Marriage, family and care for parents
note: Maxim Paul applies to his refusal of support; 12:15 adds his readiness to spend and be spent.

title: Paul warns unrepentant sinners that he will not spare them
speaker: Paul
recipient: the Corinthian church, especially those who sinned before
note: Warning before the third visit (12:20–21; 13:2); leads into AUD-51-13-5 (13:5–12). 13:1 is A085.

title: Paul's apostleship comes through Jesus Christ and God the Father
speaker: Jesus Christ and God the Father, as Paul states
note: Greeting stresses a commission not from human beings; 1 Timothy 1:1 and Titus 1:1–3 are already linked.

title: God calls Paul to proclaim his Son among the nations
speaker: God
note: Paul's own account of his call; link as Additional Scripture on the Acts 26:15–18 commission.

title: The pillars affirm Paul's mission to the nations, Peter's to the circumcised
speaker: James, Cephas and John, recognizing God's entrusting
note: AUD-52-2-9 (2:9–10) records only the request to remember the poor, not the agreed division of mission.

title: False brothers demand circumcision, but Titus is not compelled
speaker: false brothers secretly brought in
note: The demand to circumcise Gentile converts matches Acts 15:1–5 (AUD-48-15-1); 2:2 says Paul went up by revelation.

title: Paul's rebuke of Cephas: justified by faith, not works of law
speaker: Paul
note: The quoted speech runs 2:14–21 but the record stops at 2:14; includes 2:21 (P02977). A053 covers 2:19–20.

title: Paul quotes the curse on everyone who does not keep the law
speaker: Paul, quoting Deuteronomy 27:26
note: Quotes the last covenant curse of Deuteronomy 27:15–26 (C1210).

title: Paul quotes 'The righteous one will live by faith'
speaker: Paul, quoting Habakkuk 2:4
note: Habakkuk 2:4 lies inside ot-habakkuk-v2-2 (2:2–4); Romans 1:17 and Hebrews 10:38 quote it too.

title: Paul quotes 'the one who does these things will live by them'
speaker: Paul, quoting Leviticus 18:5
note: Quotes Leviticus 18:5, inside torah-leviticus-18-1.

title: Paul quotes the curse on everyone hanged on a tree
speaker: Paul, quoting Deuteronomy 21:23
note: Quotes Deuteronomy 21:23, itemized as C1120–C1122 (hanged body).

title: Paul cites the rule that a ratified covenant cannot be altered
speaker: Paul
note: Human legal analogy, as the catalogue records Romans 7:1–4 (AUD-49-7-1) as Law; grounds A079 (3:16–19).

title: Paul cites the rule that an underage heir is under guardians
speaker: Paul
note: Inheritance-law analogy like AUD-49-7-1 (Romans 7:1–4); 4:3–7 applies it to adoption as sons.

title: Become as I am: Paul's appeal recalls the Galatians' welcome
speaker: Paul
note: Extend Additional Scripture Galatians 4:8–12 to 4:8–20; 4:18 adds 'good to be zealously sought for good'.

title: Paul quotes the call to the barren woman to rejoice
speaker: Paul, quoting Isaiah 54:1
topic: Minor Teachings: The Scriptures Read in Christ
note: ot-isaiah-v54-1 is a Study Context record; link Galatians 4:27 as Additional Scripture.

title: Do not heed those who unsettle you about circumcision
speaker: Paul
note: Continues 5:1–6 against the circumcision agitators: 'the one troubling you will bear the judgment' (5:10).

title: A little leaven leavens the whole batch of dough
speaker: Paul
note: Same proverb as 1 Corinthians 5:6, inside A100 (1 Corinthians 5:6–8).

title: Boast only in the cross, not in outward circumcision
speaker: Paul
note: Closing warning and the 'rule' of new creation (6:16); no record after 6:10.

title: Paul forbids anyone to trouble him further
speaker: Paul
note: Jussive prohibition grounded in his bearing the marks of Jesus.

title: Paul's stewardship of grace for the Gentiles, revealed as mystery
speaker: God, as Paul relates
note: 3:2 'the stewardship of God's grace given to me for you' begins the commission continued in 3:7–13.

title: Let no rotten word come out; speak what builds up
speaker: Paul
note: A035's title ('builds up others') is 4:29's content; AUD-53-4-28's note says the speech verse is cited elsewhere.

title: Put away all bitterness, rage, anger, shouting, slander and malice
speaker: Paul
note: A020's title ('put away anger and bitterness') is 4:31's content, but its reference is only 4:26–27.

title: Christ cleanses the church: the pattern for husbands' love
speaker: Paul
note: Fills the gap inside A049's husbands' instruction (5:25 and 5:28–30).

title: Let each husband love his wife as himself
speaker: Paul
note: AUD-53-5-22's note says the husbands' record 'also draws on verses 31–33'; 5:31 quotes Genesis 2:24.

title: Let the wife respect her husband
speaker: Paul
note: 5:33b repeats the direction to wives; the record stops at 5:24.

title: Paul rejoices that Christ is proclaimed and magnified, in life or death
speaker: Paul
note: Paul's example, like AUD-54-4-10 (4:10–13): 'to live is Christ and to die is gain' (1:21).

title: Complete my joy by being of one mind and one love
speaker: Paul
topic: Major Teachings: The Word of Christ Handed On
note: 2:2 and 2:3–4 are one sentence; A024 begins mid-exhortation at 2:3.

title: God exalts the humbled Christ: every knee bows, every tongue confesses
speaker: Paul
topic: Major Teachings: The Word of Christ Handed On
note: Completes the Christ hymn whose humbling A024 records (2:3–8); exaltation follows humility.

title: Paul plans to send Timothy to learn of the Philippians' state
speaker: Paul
recipient: Timothy, to be sent to the Philippian church
note: Comparable to the Epaphroditus record AUD-54-2-25 (2:25–30) and Timothy's mission in AUD-56-3-1.

title: Count all things loss for the surpassing worth of knowing Christ
speaker: Paul
note: Paul's example between AUD-54-3-1 (3:1–3) and AUD-54-3-12 (3:12–21); 3:17 asks readers to imitate it.

title: Gifts for gospel work are a sacrifice pleasing to God
speaker: Paul
note: Paul commends their giving and seeks 'the fruit that increases to your account'; cf. A104 (Hebrews 13:16).

title: Greet every saint in Christ Jesus
speaker: Paul
topic: Major Teachings: The Word of Christ Handed On
note: AUD-50-16-20 groups Paul's closing greeting instructions as parallels; this one is not linked.

title: Continue in the faith, steadfast and not shifting from the gospel's hope
speaker: Paul
note: Conditional exhortation (1:23); 1:23b 'of which I, Paul, became a servant' leads into AUD-55-1-24.

title: Paul struggles so believers reach full knowledge of Christ
speaker: Paul
note: Paul's labor for maturity in 1:28–29 continues directly into 2:1–3.

title: Let no one deceive you with persuasive argument
speaker: Paul
note: Same warning as 2:8 ('Watch out that no one carries you off'), stated first at 2:4.

title: Brothers, pray also for us
speaker: Paul, Silvanus and Timothy
note: Same senders' request for prayer as 2 Thessalonians 3:1–2 (AUD-57-3-1).

title: Do not be deceived by the lawless one's signs and wonders
speaker: Paul, Silvanus and Timothy
note: Explains 2:1–4: the restrainer, the lawless one's deceptions, and delusion for those refusing the truth.

title: The trustworthy saying that Christ Jesus came to save sinners
speaker: Paul
note: The only Pastoral 'trustworthy saying' without a record (cf. A056, AUD-58-3-1, AUD-60-3-8); 1:12 is in AUD-48-26-15.

title: Pray for all, for God wills all people to be saved
speaker: Paul
recipient: Timothy and the church at Ephesus
note: 2:4 completes the sentence of 2:3; the one mediator and ransom for all ground the prayer for all.

title: Paul writes so Timothy knows how to conduct himself in God's household
speaker: Paul
note: States the purpose of the church-order directions of chapters 2–3; 3:16 is a confession.

title: Onesiphorus, unashamed of Paul's chain, contrasts with those who turned away
speaker: Paul
note: Examples of the charge 'do not be ashamed... of me his prisoner' (1:8); the blessings in 1:16, 18 are out of scope.

title: Paul endures all things for the chosen; God's word is not chained
speaker: Paul
note: 2:9 completes the sentence of 2:8 ('my gospel, for which I suffer hardship'); same call to endure hardship.

title: Recognize those who creep into households and oppose the truth
speaker: Paul
note: Describes the people Timothy must turn away from (3:5), likened to Jannes and Jambres.

title: All who want to live godly lives in Christ will be persecuted
speaker: Paul
note: Timothy followed Paul's conduct and sufferings (3:10–11); leads into AUD-59-3-14 (3:14–17).

title: Paul has fought the good fight and awaits the crown of righteousness
speaker: Paul
note: 4:6 ('For I am already being poured out') grounds the charge of 4:1–5.

title: Paul asks Timothy to come quickly, bringing Mark, his cloak and books
speaker: Paul
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Personal requests with no record; 4:21 repeats 'come before winter'. Compare AUD-60-3-13 (Titus 3:13).

title: Paul sends Tychicus to Ephesus
speaker: Paul
note: AUD-53-6-21 records Tychicus's sending (Ephesians 6:21–22; Colossians 4:7–9).

title: Greet Prisca and Aquila and the household of Onesiphorus
speaker: Paul
topic: Major Teachings: The Word of Christ Handed On
note: AUD-50-16-20 groups Paul's closing greeting instructions as parallels.

title: The trustworthy saying: God saved us by mercy, not by our works
speaker: Paul
note: The 'trustworthy saying' and 'these things' Titus must insist on (3:8) are 3:4–7; 3:3 grounds 3:1–2.

title: Paul tells Titus to come to Nicopolis when Artemas or Tychicus arrives
speaker: Paul
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Also reports the planned sending of Artemas or Tychicus to relieve Titus.

title: Greet those who love us in faith
speaker: Paul
topic: Major Teachings: The Word of Christ Handed On
note: AUD-50-16-20 groups Paul's closing greeting instructions as parallels.

title: Paul trusts Philemon's obedience to do even more than asked
speaker: Paul
note: Closes the appeal about Onesimus that A029 records (1:8–20).

title: Paul asks Philemon to prepare a guest room for him
speaker: Paul
note: Distinct request (lodging) from the Onesimus appeal; Paul hopes to be released through their prayers.

title: Angels are sent out to serve those who will inherit salvation
speaker: God, as Hebrews states
note: Rhetorical question naming the angels' standing commission; cf. AUD-62-1-6 (1:6). The psalms quoted in 1:5–12 have no records.

title: God's living word judges the heart; all must give account
speaker: the author of Hebrews
note: Extend its Additional Scripture Hebrews 4:1–11 to 4:1–13; 4:12–13 ground the call to enter the rest (4:11).

title: No one takes the high priest's honor unless called, as Aaron was
speaker: the author of Hebrews
note: Recalls Exodus 28:1 (C0285); 5:4 also echoes Numbers 17:5 (C0868), no outsider approaching.

title: The high priest offers for his own sins as for the people's
speaker: the author of Hebrews
note: Recalls Leviticus 16:6, 11 (C0554; also C0462, Leviticus 9:7). Cited again at 7:27.

title: Take seriously the warning against falling away after enlightenment
speaker: the author of Hebrews
note: Same apostasy warning as 10:26–31; alternatively extend AUD-62-5-11, since 6:4 continues 6:1–3.

title: Hold fast the hope secured by God's oath to Abraham
speaker: the author of Hebrews
note: Abraham 'waited patiently and obtained the promise' (6:15) illustrates 6:12; 6:18 urges holding fast the hope.

title: An oath by one greater confirms a matter and ends dispute
speaker: the author of Hebrews
note: Human oath practice used as analogy, as with oaths settling disputes in torah-exodus-22-1 (Exodus 22:11).

title: No one from Judah served at the altar under Moses' law
speaker: the author of Hebrews
note: Recalls the restriction of priesthood to Aaron's line (Numbers 3:10, C0774; Exodus 28:1, C0285).

title: High priests offer first for their own sins, then the people's
speaker: the author of Hebrews
note: Recalls Leviticus 16:6, 11 (C0554); the same law is cited at 5:3.

title: Every high priest is appointed to offer gifts and sacrifices
speaker: the author of Hebrews
note: Repeats 5:1 (linked to C0285 above); priests 'offer the gifts according to law'. 8:5 is already linked to C0252.

title: The first covenant's earthly sanctuary and its furnishings
speaker: the author of Hebrews
note: Recounts the commanded tent, veil (C0274), ark with tablets (C0256) and cover; 8:5 is already linked to C0252.

title: The golden jar of manna kept before the Testimony
speaker: the author of Hebrews
note: Recalls Exodus 16:32–34 (C0131).

title: Aaron's sprouted rod kept before the Testimony
speaker: the author of Hebrews
note: Recalls Numbers 17:25 (C0872).

title: The heifer's ashes sprinkled on the defiled for cleanness
speaker: the author of Hebrews
note: Recalls the red-heifer water sprinkled with hyssop (Numbers 19:18, C0899; also C0893, C0898).

title: A testament takes effect only at the death of its maker
speaker: the author of Hebrews
note: Inheritance-law analogy for the new covenant, like AUD-49-7-1 (Romans 7:1–4).

title: The first covenant was inaugurated and cleansed with blood
speaker: the author of Hebrews
note: Its Additional Scripture Hebrews 9:19–20 should run 9:18–22; 9:21 recalls Leviticus 8, 9:22 Leviticus 17:11.

title: The high priest enters the holy places yearly with another's blood
speaker: the author of Hebrews
note: Recalls the annual Day of Atonement (Leviticus 16:32–34, C0570; entry restriction C0547).

title: Yearly sacrifices bring a reminder of sins
speaker: the author of Hebrews
note: The annual atonement law (C0570); A103 begins at 10:4.

title: Every priest stands daily offering the same sacrifices
speaker: the author of Hebrews
note: Recalls the daily offerings (Exodus 29:38–42, C0333).

title: Christ sits at God's right hand awaiting the footstool
speaker: the author of Hebrews
topic: Minor Teachings: The Scriptures Read in Christ
note: Echoes Greek Psalm 109:1, already linked at Hebrews 1:13.

title: The Spirit testifies to the new covenant written on hearts
speaker: the author of Hebrews
topic: Minor Teachings: The Scriptures Read in Christ
note: Requotes Jeremiah 31:33–34 as in Hebrews 8:8–12 (A090, a Study Context record); Jeremiah 31 itself has no record.

title: Faith is the assurance of things hoped for
speaker: the author of Hebrews
note: The definition heading the examples that A072 begins at 11:4; 11:6 (in A072) depends on it.

title: Abraham, Sarah, Isaac and Jacob as examples of faith
speaker: the author of Hebrews
note: Matches A072 (11:4–7) and A073 (11:24–27); 11:13–16 adds living as sojourners seeking a heavenly homeland.

title: Abraham obeys God's call to go out to the promised place
speaker: the author of Hebrews
topic: Creation, personal commissions and Israel’s journeys
note: Recalls Genesis 12:1 (C0021), already linked to Acts 7:2–4.

title: By faith Abraham, when tested, offered Isaac
speaker: the author of Hebrews
topic: Creation, personal commissions and Israel’s journeys
note: Recalls Genesis 22:2 (C0049); 11:18 quotes Genesis 21:12 (C0045).

title: Moses' parents hide him, unafraid of the king's decree
speaker: the author of Hebrews
note: The 'king's decree' is Pharaoh's order in Exodus 1:22 (ot-exodus-v1-22).

title: Israel, Rahab, the judges, prophets and martyrs as examples of faith
speaker: the author of Hebrews
note: Continues A073 (11:24–27); 11:39–40 conclude that all awaited the promise perfected with us.

title: By faith Moses kept the Passover and the sprinkling of blood
speaker: the author of Hebrews
note: Recalls Exodus 12:7 (C0095), within torah-exodus-12-1.

title: By faith Israel crossed the Red Sea on dry land
speaker: the author of Hebrews
topic: Creation, personal commissions and Israel’s journeys
note: Recalls Exodus 14:15–16 (C0121).

title: Jericho's walls fall after seven days of encircling
speaker: the author of Hebrews
note: ot-joshua-v6-8 carries the encircling command (Joshua 6:3–5) as Additional Scripture.

title: Resist sin, though not yet to the point of blood
speaker: the author of Hebrews
note: Continues the race and 'consider Jesus' of 12:1–3 and leads into A115 (12:5–11).

title: You have come not to Sinai but to Mount Zion
speaker: the author of Hebrews
note: The Sinai–Zion contrast grounds 12:25 ('See that you do not refuse the One who speaks'); 12:20 is C0140.

title: Israel begs that no further word be spoken to them
speaker: the author of Hebrews
topic: Creation, personal commissions and Israel’s journeys
note: Recalls Exodus 20:19 (ot-exodus-v20-19); Deuteronomy 5:25 is ot-deuteronomy-v5-25.

title: The author asks for prayer so he may be restored sooner
speaker: the author of Hebrews
note: No record after 13:17; compare Paul's prayer requests AUD-57-3-1 and AUD-49-15-30.

title: Bear with the word of encouragement
speaker: the author of Hebrews
topic: Major Teachings: The Word of Christ Handed On
note: Closing request to receive the letter's exhortation patiently.

title: Greet all your leaders and all the saints
speaker: the author of Hebrews
topic: Major Teachings: The Word of Christ Handed On
note: AUD-50-16-20 groups closing greeting instructions as parallels (it includes 1 Peter 5:14).

summary: 98 findings (27 new, 31 extend, 40 parallel): Ephesians 4:29, 4:31 and 5:31–33 fall outside records whose titles already cover them; personal requests in 2 Timothy 4, Titus 3:12, Philemon 22 and Hebrews 13 are unrecorded; Hebrews' Torah references and chapter 11 examples are mostly unlinked.
